name: Ausse Ealdwine
source: Narcissistic and womanizer. When he is with Ciarán he tends to become more of a dunce and childish even though he is at the top of the class when it comes to studies, becoming another class clown, but without him he becomes a ladies man with some lovers here and there. Or at least that’s what he says. He’s also rich, but it’s probably the only thing he doesn’t like to brag about.
